Metadata.title: STEADYVIEW — Precision Inspection Solutions
Metadata.description: STEADYVIEW is a B2B company developing 2D/3D machine vision and industrial X-ray inspection equipment.

HomePage.intro: STEADYVIEW engineers 2D/3D machine vision and industrial X-ray inspection equipment that protects quality on battery and semiconductor production lines, catching micro defects that are easy to miss.
HomePage.productsSub: Find the right solution for your inspection needs.
HomePage.ctaBannerBody: Review specifications and use cases, then request a tailored quote.

HomeHero.slide1Desc: High-speed, high-precision inspection of secondary battery cap and electrode surfaces.
HomeHero.slide2Desc: X-ray CT inspects internal defects and foreign material in batteries without damage.
HomeHero.slide3Desc: High-precision 3D shape measurement detects bump and surface defects on semiconductors.

AboutPage.heroIntro: STEADYVIEW builds trust in precision inspection through 2D/3D machine vision and industrial X-ray equipment.
AboutPage.promiseSteadyBody: With flawless 3D analysis that tolerates no margin of error and X-ray technology that sees into the deepest corners, we guarantee the highest inspection accuracy — steady even in the harshest manufacturing environments.
AboutPage.promiseViewBody: Beyond simple defect detection, we will be a leading technology partner that maximizes our customers' productivity and looks ahead to the future of the smart factory.

CeoPage.title: CEO Message
CeoPage.intro: I am the CEO of STEADYVIEW Co., Ltd.
CeoPage.body1: Today's global manufacturing industry demands stricter quality control than ever, as nanoscale processes converge with advanced technology. In an era when a single microscopic defect can determine the safety of an entire system, flawless inspection is no longer optional — it is a survival strategy for every enterprise.
CeoPage.body2: STEADYVIEW meets this demand as an industrial inspection equipment company providing ultra-precision machine vision, 3D, and X-ray inspection solutions that see beyond the limits of the human eye.
CeoPage.promiseLead: Our company name, "STEADYVIEW," carries two firm commitments.
CeoPage.promiseSteadyBody: With flawless 3D analysis that tolerates no margin of error and X-ray technology that sees into the deepest corners, we guarantee the highest inspection accuracy — steady even in the harshest manufacturing environments.
CeoPage.promiseViewBody: Beyond simple defect detection, we will be a leading technology partner that maximizes our customers' productivity and looks ahead to the future of the smart factory.
CeoPage.body3: We place technical substance over superficial appeal, and unwavering trust with our customers above all else. Through continuous R&D investment and proprietary ultra-precision image processing technology, we will raise the quality standards of Korea's and the world's advanced industries — including semiconductors, batteries, and automotive components — to a new level.
CeoPage.body4: With an ever-steady view toward our customers' success, we promise to stand together as the most trusted, top-tier global partner in inspection equipment.
CeoPage.closing: We ask for your continued warm interest and support for STEADYVIEW's unwavering challenge ahead.
